TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the ATM.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period assigned by the ATM.

CompletionRequired.name: Completion Required
CompletionRequired.definition: True if a completion advice has to be sent after the end of the transaction.|Usage: When absent, default value is True.

TotalAuthorisedAmount.name: Total Authorised Amount
TotalAuthorisedAmount.definition: Total authorised amount of the deposit transaction.

AdditionalCharge.name: Additional Charge
AdditionalCharge.definition: Additional charge (for instance tax or fee).

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Sequence of one or more TLV data elements from the ATM application, in accordance with ISO 7816-6, not in a specific order. Present if the transaction is performed with an EMV chip card application.

Command.name: Command
Command.definition: Maintenance command to perform on the ATM.

AccountInformation.name: Account Information
AccountInformation.definition: Account information associated to the customer.
